name: Hispanic Serving Institution
description:
Sacramento State is committed to using research and best practices to increase awareness and ability to intentionally serve Latine students. We reached a 25% undergraduate Latine student enrollment in 2013 and were recognized as an HSI in 2015.

A HSI is a federal designation of a public or private college or university that has an enrollment of Pell-eligible and under-resourced undergraduate full-time equivalent students that is at least 25% Latine students.

name: El Centro Serna
description:
El Centro Serna is dedicated to cultivating an environment that champions leadership, empowerment, self-advocacy, and civic engagement among those interested in culture, heritage, and life of Chicanx/Latinx students and those from other under-represented backgrounds at Sacramento State University.

Support Services:
• Advising Guidance
• Financial Aid & Scholarships Guidance
• Internship/Job Search Assistance
• Career Exploration & Guidance

name: PRIDE Center
description:
Support Services:
• Social activities and community building events (arts, crafts, games, movies, etc.)
• Pride Center library
• One-on-one advising sessions with faculty or mentor
• Rainbow ally training
supportServices: Social activities and community building events (arts, crafts, games, movies, etc.)

name: Dreamer Resource Center
description:
The Dreamer Resource Center (DRC) helps students in navigating their undergraduate and/or graduate journey. We prioritize fostering a sense of community for students by offering services that may fit their specific needs. These services include but are NOT limited to:

Support Services:
• Scholarship Assistance and Fellowships
• Career Development (Resume/Cover Letter Building, Career/Major Exploration, Interview Prep, etc.)
• Community Events and Workshops (Paint N' Sip, Bracelet-Making, Credit Cards 101, etc.)
• Free Immigration Legal Services
supportServices: Career Development (Resume/Cover Letter Building, Career/Major Exploration, Interview Prep, etc.)
Community Events and Workshops (Paint N' Sip, Bracelet-Making, Credit Cards 101, etc.)

name: College Assistance Migrant Program
description:
The College Assistance Migrant Program (CAMP) is a federally funded program designed to serve students from migrant and seasonal farm working backgrounds succeed at Sacramento State. CAMP facilitates the transition from high school to college and offers first-year support services to develop skills necessary to persist and graduate from college in a timely manner.

Support Services:
• New Student orientation and housing
• Advising (personal, academic, and career)
• Academic planning, course selection, and registration
• FAFSA and scholarship application
supportServices: Academic planning, course selection, and registration

name: Center for Science and Math Success
description:
The Center for Science and Math Success at Sacramento State empowers students to achieve their personal and professional goals through equity-based programs that cultivate life-long learning skills, leadership development, and a sense of belonging.

Support Services:
• One-on-One Advising and peer mentoring
• Access to a Study Room
• Research Opportunities
• Scholarships

name: Career Center
description:
Through a collaborative career development approach, the Career Center engages, educates and empowers our students and alumni to thrive and successfully contribute to our community, economy and future workforce.

They develop employer and community partnerships to recruit, collaborate with and inform our talented students and alumni.

Support Services:
• Provide students career counseling
• Provide connections to internships
• Provide connections to employers
• Give students a wide range of tools to provide major steps in their careers
supportServices: Give students a wide range of tools to provide major steps in their careers

name: MESA
description:
The mission of the Mathematics, Engineering, and Science Achievement (MESA) Program is to recruit, retain, professionally develop, and graduate students with degrees in engineering, computer science and construction management.

MESA Benefits and Services:
• One-on-one advising services and peer mentoring
• Scholarships
• Industry Mentorship opportunities
• Academic Excellence Workshops
supportServices: One-on-one advising services and peer mentoring

name: The Well
description:
Our Student Health, Counseling and Wellness center provides an integrated approach to care combining both physical, mental and various needs of our students. Our multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals fosters an inclusive culture that addresses systemic disparities and creates an environment where individuals from diverse backgrounds feel respected, valued, and are provided with equitable access to quality care.

Support Services:
• Gender Affirming Care
• Immunizations & Vaccines
• Laboratory Testing and X-Ray
• Medical Abortion
• Mental Health Counseling
• Women's Health Exams
